description: This script is a test suite that verifies 'git status' behavior with symbolic links in a version-controlled directory. It sets up test cases involving symlinks to directories, symlinks replacing directories, and compares the actual git status output to expected results.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs a shell command, and checks the output against expected results.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to execute after the test.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or strings for equality, used to verify test outputs.
